statement: The recorded recurring payment is not safe or correct to approve because Mr. Vega cancelled his Fitline membership in writing on 3 July with confirmation from the club.
judge_text:
WRONG
It states the charge "is not safe or correct to approve because Mr. Vega cancelled his Fitline membership," contradicting the record's "active, renewing" status.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
